headlines.title: Philip Morris International (PM) Puts €343 Billion EU Footprint At The Center
headlines.summary: Philip Morris International (NYSE:PM) released a new EU Economic Footprint Study reporting a €343b contribution to the European economy. The review shows smoke free products now account for more than half of PMI's net revenues in Europe. The study highlights PMI's links to employment and exports across EU markets and urges policy support for reduced risk products. PMI's quantified €343b EU impact and majority smoke free revenue share only capture one side of this transformation story.

description: Philip Morris International Inc. operates as a tobacco company. The company offers cigarettes and smoke-free products, including heat-not-burn, e-vapor, and oral nicotine products under the IQOS, VEEV, and ZYN brands; and consumer accessories, such as lighters and matches. It also offers wellness products. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut.
